name: Traditional Steamed Idli with Coconut Chutney
description: Soft and fluffy fermented rice and urad dal cakes paired with fresh coconut dip.
steps: Soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek separately for 5 hours.
Grind to a smooth batter, add salt and ferment overnight.
Pour into greased idli moulds and steam for 10-12 minutes.
Grind coconut with green chillies and salt; temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Serve hot idlis with the chutney.

name: Crispy Golden Dosa with Vegetable Sambar
description: Golden crispy fermented crepe served with warm lentil-vegetable sambar.
steps: Grind soaked rice and urad dal into a batter and ferment overnight.
Pressure cook toor dal; simmer drumstick and carrot in tamarind water with sambar powder, then add dal.
Heat a tawa, spread a ladle of batter thin and drizzle oil.
Cook until crisp and golden, fold and serve with hot sambar.

name: Kerala Puttu with Kadala Curry
description: Steamed ground rice cylinders served with rich spiced black chickpea curry.
steps: Moisten rice flour with warm salted water until crumbly.
Layer the puttu steamer with coconut and flour; steam for 6-8 minutes.
Pressure cook the soaked black chickpeas.
Saute shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil, add garam masala and chickpeas, simmer until thick.
Serve hot puttu with kadala curry.

name: Soft Appam with Vegetable Coconut Stew
description: Lacy fermented rice pancakes served with vegetables simmered in coconut milk.
steps: Mix rice flour, thin coconut milk, yeast and sugar; ferment for 6 hours.
Swirl batter in an appam pan, cover and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Simmer diced vegetables with ginger and green chilli in thin coconut milk.
Finish the stew with thick coconut milk and crushed cardamom.
Serve appams with warm stew.

name: Vegetable Poha with Roasted Peanuts
description: Fluffy flattened rice tossed with onions, peas, crunchy peanuts and lemon.
steps: Rinse poha and drain well.
Splutter mustard seeds in oil and roast the peanuts until crunchy.
Saute onion, green chilli and curry leaves; add turmeric and peas.
Fold in poha, steam covered for 2 minutes and finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Paneer Stuffed Paratha with Fresh Curd
description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced paneer, served with curd.
steps: Knead a soft dough with wheat flour, salt and water.
Mix grated paneer with chopped chilli, cumin and amchur.
Stuff the dough ball, seal and roll out evenly.
Roast on a hot tawa with ghee and serve with curd.

name: Masala Scrambled Eggs with Multigrain Toast
description: Protein-packed scrambled eggs with onions, tomatoes and chillies on toast.
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Saute onion, tomato and chilli in olive oil until soft.
Add eggs and scramble gently on low heat.
Toast the bread and top with the eggs and coriander.

name: Blueberry Almond Oatmeal Bowl
description: Rolled oats cooked in almond milk, topped with blueberries and almond butter.
steps: Simmer oats in almond milk for 6 minutes.
Stir in cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Top with blueberries, almond butter and chia seeds.

name: Tomato Onion Uttapam
description: Thick, soft dosa topped with tomato, onion and green chilli.
steps: Use fermented rice and urad dal batter.
Pour a thick round on a hot tawa.
Press chopped tomato, onion, chilli and coriander on top.
Drizzle oil, flip after 2 minutes and cook until golden.

name: Rava Upma
description: Savoury semolina porridge tempered with mustard, ginger and curry leaves.
steps: Dry roast semolina until aromatic and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; saute onion, ginger, chilli and carrot.
Add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Stir in semolina slowly, cover and cook for 3 minutes.

name: Masala Omelette
description: Fluffy Indian omelette loaded with onion, tomato and green chilli.
steps: Beat eggs with salt.
Mix in finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Pour onto a hot oiled pan and cook until set.
Flip, cook for a minute and serve.

name: Aloo Paratha with Curd
description: Wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato, roasted with ghee.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with chilli, coriander, garam masala and salt.
Stuff dough balls with the filling and roll out gently.
Roast on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.
Serve with curd.

name: Besan Tomato Chilla
description: High-protein gram flour pancakes with tomato and onion.
steps: Whisk besan with water, salt and turmeric into a smooth batter.
Stir in chopped tomato, onion, chilli and coriander.
Spread thin on a hot oiled pan.
Cook both sides until golden spots appear.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Three-ingredient style pancakes sweetened only with ripe banana.
steps: Blend oats, banana, eggs and milk into a thick batter.
Pour small rounds on a lightly greased pan.
Cook until bubbles form, flip and cook for another minute.
Serve with a drizzle of honey.

name: Vegetable Semiya Upma
description: Roasted vermicelli cooked with vegetables and South Indian tempering.
steps: Roast the vermicelli until golden.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, saute onion and chilli.
Add carrot, peas, salt and 2 cups water; bring to a boil.
Add vermicelli and cook until the water is absorbed.

name: Egg Bhurji with Buttered Toast
description: Spicy Indian scrambled eggs with tomato served with buttered toast.
steps: Saute onion and chilli until soft, add tomato and spices.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir continuously until cooked.
Toast the bread with butter.
Serve the bhurji hot with toast.

name: Ragi Onion Dosa
description: Instant finger millet dosa with onion and cumin, rich in calcium.
steps: Mix both flours with water and salt into a thin batter.
Add chopped onion, chilli, cumin and curry leaves.
Pour the batter from the edges onto a hot tawa to make a lacy dosa.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

name: Paneer Bhurji Toast
description: Crumbled paneer with capsicum and tomato piled on toast.
steps: Saute onion, chilli and capsicum.
Add tomato and turmeric and cook until soft.
Crumble in the paneer and toss for 2 minutes.
Spoon over toasted bread.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
description: Quick energy breakfast of toast, peanut butter and sliced banana.
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter evenly.
Top with banana slices and a pinch of cinnamon.

name: Nutrient Green Apple & Banana Smoothie
description: Antioxidant smoothie with crisp apple, sweet banana and chia seeds.
steps: Slice the banana and core the apple.
Blend with almond milk and chia seeds until creamy.
Serve chilled.

name: Mixed Berry & Chia Greek Yogurt Bowl
description: Thick Greek yogurt layered with berries, chia seeds and pistachios.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a chilled bowl.
Arrange berries on top.
Sprinkle chia seeds and crushed pistachios.

name: Steamed Sprouted Moong Salad
description: Lightly steamed sprouts tossed with cucumber, pomegranate and lemon.
steps: Steam the sprouts for 4 minutes.
Toss with diced cucumber, pomegranate and mint.
Season with chaat masala and lemon juice.

name: Roasted Almonds & Walnut Energy Mix
description: Dry-roasted almonds, walnuts and pumpkin seeds with a pinch of salt.
steps: Dry roast nuts and seeds for 5 minutes.
Dust with salt while warm.
Cool before serving.

name: Fresh Papaya & Lime Bowl with Mint
description: Sweet papaya cubes finished with fresh lime juice and black salt.
steps: Peel and cube the papaya.
Drizzle with lime juice.
Sprinkle black salt and garnish with mint.

name: Cucumber Mint Masala Buttermilk (Chaas)
description: Cooling probiotic drink whipped with roasted cumin, cucumber and mint.
steps: Whisk curd and chilled water until frothy.
Blend in grated cucumber, roasted cumin, black salt and mint.
Serve chilled.

name: Papaya Banana Smoothie
description: Creamy tropical smoothie that is gentle on digestion.
steps: Add papaya, banana and milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Sweeten with honey if needed and serve chilled.

name: Papaya Lassi
description: Thick, cooling yogurt drink blended with ripe papaya.
steps: Blend papaya with curd and sugar.
Add a little chilled water for a pourable consistency.
Finish with a pinch of cardamom.

name: Tropical Fruit Salad
description: Papaya, pineapple and banana tossed in lime and mint.
steps: Cube all the fruit.
Toss with lime juice.
Top with pomegranate and torn mint.

name: Papaya Tomato Salsa
description: Sweet-and-tangy salsa of ripe papaya, tomato and onion with lime.
steps: Dice papaya, tomato and onion finely.
Mix with chopped chilli and coriander.
Season with lime juice and salt; rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with crackers or as a side.

name: Masala Fruit Chaat
description: Apple, banana and papaya tossed with chaat masala and lemon.
steps: Chop the fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Sprinkle chaat masala and squeeze lemon over.
Toss and serve immediately.

name: Mango Lassi
description: Classic mango and yogurt drink with a hint of cardamom.
steps: Blend mango pulp with curd and sugar.
Thin with chilled water if needed.
Serve with a pinch of cardamom.

name: Watermelon Mint Cooler
description: Hydrating watermelon drink with lime and mint.
steps: Blend watermelon with mint.
Strain if you like it smooth.
Add lime juice and black salt and serve over ice.

name: Spicy Guava Chaat
description: Guava wedges dusted with chilli and chaat masala.
steps: Cut guava into wedges.
Sprinkle chaat masala and chilli powder.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Date & Nut Energy Balls
description: No-bake bites of dates, almonds and cashews.
steps: Pulse nuts coarsely in a blender.
Add dates and blend into a sticky mixture.
Roll into balls and coat with coconut.
Chill for 20 minutes.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
description: Filling smoothie with banana, peanut butter and milk.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.

name: Whole Wheat Chapati with Vegetable Curry
description: Soft whole-wheat flatbread with seasonal mixed vegetable curry.
steps: Knead dough and roll out thin chapatis; cook on a tawa until puffed.
Saute onion and tomato into a masala with garam masala.
Add chopped vegetables and a splash of water; simmer until tender.
Serve hot with chapatis.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani Bowl
description: Fragrant basmati layered with spiced marinated chicken and caramelised onions.
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger, garlic and biryani masala.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Fry onions in ghee until golden.
Layer chicken, rice, onions and mint in a heavy pot.
Cook on low heat for 25 minutes.

name: South Indian Thali: Rice, Sambar & Avial
description: Complete meal of steamed rice, lentil sambar and coconut avial.
steps: Cook rice until fluffy.
Prepare sambar with toor dal, drumstick, tamarind and sambar powder.
Cook carrot and raw banana with coconut paste and curd for avial.
Serve together with curry leaves tempering.

name: Yellow Dal Tadka with Jeera Rice
description: Creamy yellow lentils tempered with garlic and cumin, with cumin rice.
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric and salt.
Temper cumin and sliced garlic in oil; add onion and tomato.
Pour the tadka over the dal and simmer.
Saute cumin with rice and cook for jeera rice.

name: Herb Grilled Chicken Breast with Quinoa
description: Herb-marinated chicken over fluffy quinoa with steamed broccoli.
steps: Marinate chicken with garlic, rosemary and lemon juice.
Grill for 6-7 minutes per side.
Cook quinoa and steam the broccoli.
Serve sliced chicken over quinoa.

name: Creamy Palak Paneer with Whole Wheat Phulkas
description: Paneer cubes in silky spiced spinach gravy with phulkas.
steps: Blanch spinach and puree.
Saute garlic, ginger, onion and tomato; stir in puree and paneer.
Simmer 5 minutes and finish with cream.
Cook phulkas on an open flame and serve.

name: Spiced Punjabi Chana Masala with Brown Rice
description: Chickpeas simmered in an onion-tomato gravy served over steamed rice.
steps: Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas.
Saute onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato puree and chana masala; simmer chickpeas for 15 minutes.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Homestyle Egg Curry with Steamed Rice
description: Boiled eggs simmered in a mildly spiced onion-tomato gravy.
steps: Boil and peel the eggs; sear them with turmeric and chilli.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato into a thick gravy.
Add the eggs and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Tomato Rice
description: Tangy one-pot South Indian rice cooked with ripe tomatoes.
steps: Cook the rice and spread it out to cool.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; saute onion and chilli.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt and garam masala; cook until mushy.
Fold in the rice and garnish with coriander.

name: Tomato Rasam
description: Peppery, tangy tomato broth that is light and comforting.
steps: Simmer crushed tomatoes and garlic with tamarind water.
Add rasam powder, salt and cooked dal water.
Bring to a froth without boiling hard.
Temper with mustard and curry leaves; garnish with coriander.

name: Tomato Dal
description: Everyday toor dal brightened with lots of tomato and cumin.
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric.
Temper cumin and garlic; saute onion and chilli.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Mix in dal, simmer 5 minutes and garnish.

name: Lemon Rice
description: Zesty turmeric rice with crunchy dals and curry leaves.
steps: Temper mustard seeds, chana dal and urad dal in oil.
Add chilli, ginger, curry leaves and turmeric.
Fold in cooled rice and salt.
Turn off heat and mix in lemon juice.

name: Curd Rice
description: Cooling South Indian comfort food of rice mixed with curd and tempering.
steps: Mash the rice lightly and mix with curd, milk and salt.
Temper mustard seeds, ginger, chilli and curry leaves.
Pour over the rice and mix.
Top with pomegranate and serve cool.

name: Vegetable Pulao
description: Fragrant rice cooked with mixed vegetables and whole spices.
steps: Rinse and soak rice for 20 minutes.
Saute bay leaf, onion, ginger and garlic.
Add vegetables and garam masala, then rice and 2 cups water.
Cover and cook until the rice is fluffy.

name: Aloo Gobi with Chapati
description: Dry potato and cauliflower curry with soft chapatis.
steps: Saute onion and ginger, add tomato and spices.
Add potato and cauliflower florets with salt.
Cover and cook on low heat until tender.
Serve with fresh chapatis.

name: Bhindi Masala with Roti
description: Crisp okra tossed with onion, tomato and dry mango powder.
steps: Wash and dry okra completely, then slice.
Stir fry okra until no longer slimy.
Add onion, tomato, spices and amchur; cook 5 minutes.
Serve with rotis.

name: Kerala Sambar with Rice
description: Tamarind-lentil stew loaded with drumstick, brinjal and shallots.
steps: Cook toor dal until soft.
Simmer vegetables in tamarind water with sambar powder.
Add dal and simmer 10 minutes.
Temper with mustard and curry leaves; serve with rice.

name: Cabbage Thoran with Rice
description: Kerala stir fry of shredded cabbage with fresh coconut.
steps: Crush coconut with shallots and green chilli.
Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
Add cabbage, salt and turmeric; cook covered 5 minutes.
Mix in the coconut and serve with rice.

name: Beetroot Thoran
description: Bright beetroot stir fry with coconut and green chilli.
steps: Grate or finely chop the beetroot.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Cook beetroot with salt until tender.
Add coconut crushed with chilli and toss well.

name: Raw Papaya Thoran with Rice
description: Green papaya stir fried with coconut, garlic and curry leaves.
steps: Grate the raw papaya.
Crush coconut with garlic and chilli.
Temper mustard and curry leaves, add papaya and salt and cook covered.
Mix in coconut and serve with rice.

name: Kappa Puzhukku (Mashed Tapioca)
description: Kerala-style tapioca mashed with a coconut-shallot paste.
steps: Peel, cube and boil tapioca with salt and turmeric; drain.
Crush coconut with shallots, garlic and chilli.
Mix the paste into the tapioca and mash lightly.
Temper with mustard and curry leaves.

name: Pumpkin Erissery
description: Onam favourite of pumpkin and chickpeas in coconut-cumin paste.
steps: Cook pumpkin cubes with turmeric and salt.
Grind half the coconut with cumin and chilli; add to pumpkin with chickpeas.
Roast remaining coconut until brown.
Temper with mustard and curry leaves and fold in the roasted coconut.

name: Chicken Curry with Rice
description: Homestyle chicken simmered in onion-tomato masala.
steps: Saute onions until golden; add ginger and garlic.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until oil separates.
Add chicken and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Garnish and serve with rice.

name: Mushroom Masala with Chapati
description: Mushrooms in a spiced onion-tomato gravy.
steps: Saute onion, ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and spices and cook to a thick masala.
Add sliced mushrooms and capsicum; cook 8 minutes.
Serve with chapatis.

name: Soya Chunks Curry with Rice
description: Protein-rich soya chunks in a spicy gravy.
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water and squeeze dry.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato into a masala.
Add soya chunks and water; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

name: Masoor Dal with Jeera Rice
description: Quick red lentil dal paired with cumin rice.
steps: Boil masoor dal until soft.
Temper cumin and garlic; add onion and tomato.
Combine with dal and simmer.
Serve with jeera rice.

name: Kadhi Chawal
description: Tangy yogurt and gram flour curry served with rice.
steps: Whisk curd, besan, turmeric and water until smooth.
Simmer on low heat, stirring, for 15 minutes.
Temper fenugreek, ginger, chilli and curry leaves; pour in.
Serve with steamed rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed rice with scrambled egg and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir fry garlic, carrot and capsicum on high heat.
Add rice, soy sauce and eggs; toss well.
Finish with spring onion.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Indo-Chinese fried rice with beans, carrot and capsicum.
steps: Chop vegetables finely.
Stir fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add rice, soy sauce and pepper and toss.
Garnish with spring onion.

name: Pavakka Mezhukkupuratti (Bitter Gourd Fry)
description: Crisp Kerala-style bitter gourd stir fry with onion.
steps: Slice bitter gourd thin and rub with salt; squeeze out the juice.
Fry in coconut oil until edges crisp.
Add onion and chilli powder and cook until caramelised.
Finish with curry leaves.

name: Boiled Egg Salad with Black Pepper
description: High-protein snack of boiled eggs, cucumber and lemon.
steps: Hard-boil eggs for 9 minutes and peel.
Slice and toss with cucumber, pepper and lemon juice.
Serve immediately.

name: Roasted Spiced Makhana (Fox Nuts)
description: Crunchy lotus seeds roasted with turmeric and chaat masala.
steps: Heat oil on low flame.
Roast makhana for 6-8 minutes until crisp.
Sprinkle turmeric, salt and chaat masala and toss.

name: Steamed Khaman Dhokla with Mint Chutney
description: Fluffy steamed gram flour cakes with a mustard-chilli tempering.
steps: Whisk besan with turmeric, lemon juice, sugar and water.
Add soda, pour into a greased plate and steam for 15 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds and chillies in oil with a splash of water.
Pour over the dhokla and serve with mint chutney.

name: Mediterranean Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Toast topped with smashed avocado, a poached egg and chilli flakes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon, salt and pepper and spread.
Poach the egg for 3 minutes.
Top the toast with the egg and chilli flakes.

name: Warm Masala Sweet Corn Chaat
description: Steamed sweet corn tossed with chaat masala, chilli and lime.
steps: Steam corn kernels for 4 minutes.
Toss with oil, chaat masala and chilli powder.
Finish with lemon juice and serve warm.

name: Crisp Baked Vegetable Cutlet with Chutney
description: Baked patties of potato, beetroot, carrot and peas.
steps: Boil and mash the vegetables with spices.
Shape into patties and coat with breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200 C for 18 minutes until crisp.
Serve hot with chutney.

name: Kachumber Salad
description: Crunchy Indian salad of cucumber, tomato and onion.
steps: Dice cucumber, tomato and onion.
Toss with lemon juice, salt and chaat masala.
Garnish with coriander.

name: Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup
description: Silky tomato soup with roasted garlic and black pepper.
steps: Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic with olive oil for 20 minutes.
Blend with a cup of hot water until smooth.
Simmer with salt and pepper.
Garnish with basil.

name: Masala Peanut Chaat
description: Boiled peanuts tossed with onion, tomato and lemon.
steps: Boil peanuts with salt for 10 minutes and drain.
Mix with chopped onion and tomato.
Season with chaat masala and lemon juice.

name: Onion Pakoda
description: Crispy onion fritters bound with gram flour.
steps: Thinly slice onions and rub with salt.
Add besan, rice flour, chilli and curry leaves; sprinkle water to bind.
Drop small clusters into hot oil.
Fry until golden and crisp.

name: Vegetable Sandwich
description: Bombay-style sandwich with cucumber, tomato and onion.
steps: Butter the bread slices.
Layer cucumber, tomato and onion slices.
Sprinkle chaat masala and close.
Toast or grill until crisp.

name: Sprouts Chaat
description: Tangy sprouted moong with onion, tomato and lemon.
steps: Steam sprouts for 3 minutes.
Mix with chopped onion and tomato.
Season with chaat masala and lemon juice.

name: Masala Potato Wedges
description: Oven-roasted potato wedges with chilli and herbs.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges and pat dry.
Toss with oil, chilli powder, salt and herbs.
Roast at 220 C for 25 minutes, turning once.

name: Sweet Potato Chaat
description: Roasted sweet potato with chaat masala and lemon.
steps: Boil or roast sweet potatoes until tender.
Peel and cube.
Toss with chaat masala and lemon juice.

name: Masala Egg Toast
description: Bread dipped in spiced egg batter and pan toasted.
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, chopped onion, chilli and salt.
Dip bread slices in the mixture.
Toast on a greased pan until golden on both sides.

name: Paneer Tikka
description: Marinated paneer and vegetables grilled until smoky.
steps: Marinate paneer, capsicum and onion in curd, tandoori masala and lemon for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-roast until charred at the edges.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
description: Overnight chia pudding in coconut milk topped with mango.
steps: Stir chia seeds into coconut milk with jaggery.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Top with diced mango.

name: Semiya Payasam
description: Kerala vermicelli milk pudding scented with cardamom.
steps: Roast vermicelli in ghee until golden.
Add milk and simmer until the vermicelli is soft.
Stir in sugar and crushed cardamom.
Garnish with ghee-fried raisins.

name: Kerala Fish Curry with Steamed Rice
description: Tangy fish curry with kokum and coconut milk over rice.
steps: Saute shallots, ginger, garlic and chilli in coconut oil.
Add chilli powder, turmeric, kokum and water.
Simmer fish in the gravy for 8 minutes and finish with coconut milk.
Serve over rice.

name: Comforting Moong Dal Khichdi with Roasted Papad
description: Easily digestible rice and lentil khichdi with cumin ghee.
steps: Wash moong dal and rice together.
Pressure cook with turmeric, ginger and 4 cups water.
Temper cumin in ghee and stir into the khichdi.
Serve with roasted papad.

name: Grilled Salmon Bowl with Quinoa & Steamed Greens
description: Pan-seared salmon over quinoa with asparagus and broccoli.
steps: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Sear skin side down for 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 minutes.
Steam asparagus and broccoli; cook quinoa.
Plate together with a lemon drizzle.

name: Crispy Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
description: Golden tofu wok-tossed with broccoli, capsicum and soy sauce.
steps: Cube tofu and sear in sesame oil until golden.
Stir fry garlic, broccoli and capsicum for 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and tofu and toss.
Serve with steamed rice.

name: Methi Thepla with Fresh Cucumber Raita
description: Spiced fenugreek flatbread with cool cucumber raita.
steps: Knead flour, besan, methi and sesame with a little curd.
Roll thin and cook on a hot tawa with light oil.
Whisk remaining curd with grated cucumber and cumin.
Serve theplas with raita.

name: Tandoori Chicken Tikka with Roti & Salad
description: Chicken marinated in spiced yogurt, grilled and served with roti.
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger, garlic and tandoori masala for an hour.
Grill at 220 C for 18 minutes.
Cook fresh rotis on a skillet.
Serve with onion-lemon salad.

name: Nutritious Vegetable Oats Upma
description: Toasted oats cooked with mustard, curry leaves, carrot and peas.
steps: Dry roast the oats for 3 minutes.
Temper mustard and curry leaves; saute onion, ginger and vegetables.
Add water and salt, stir in oats and cook 4 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice.

name: Classic Punjabi Rajma Masala with Steamed Rice
description: Kidney beans slow-simmered in a tomato-onion-garlic gravy.
steps: Pressure cook soaked kidney beans until soft.
Saute onion, ginger, garlic and tomato into a masala.
Add rajma and simmer 20 minutes to thicken.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Shakshuka (Eggs in Spiced Tomato Sauce)
description: Eggs gently poached in a garlicky tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Saute onion, garlic and capsicum with cumin.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a thick sauce.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set; garnish and serve.

name: Vegetable Kurma with Chapati
description: Mixed vegetables in a mild coconut-spice gravy.
steps: Grind coconut with a little garam masala into a paste.
Saute onion and tomato; add vegetables and water.
Stir in the coconut paste and simmer until thick.
Serve with chapatis.

name: Kerala Egg Roast
description: Boiled eggs coated in a deeply caramelised onion masala.
steps: Boil and peel the eggs; make shallow slits.
Slow cook onions in coconut oil until deep brown.
Add ginger, garlic, tomato and spices.
Toss eggs in the masala and finish with curry leaves.

name: Baingan Bharta with Roti
description: Smoky mashed brinjal cooked with onion, tomato and garlic.
steps: Roast the brinjal over an open flame until charred; peel and mash.
Saute onion, garlic and chilli, then add tomatoes.
Mix in the brinjal and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with rotis.

name: Palak Dal
description: Toor dal simmered with fresh spinach and garlic tempering.
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric.
Saute garlic and cumin, add tomato and chopped spinach.
Add the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with rice or roti.

name: Kerala Chicken Stew
description: Mild chicken and vegetable stew in coconut milk, perfect with appam.
steps: Saute onion, ginger and chilli without browning.
Add chicken, potato, carrot and thin coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with thick coconut milk and curry leaves.
Serve with appam or bread.

name: Mutton Curry with Rice
description: Slow-cooked goat curry in a rich onion-tomato masala.
steps: Brown onions; add ginger, garlic and spices.
Add mutton and sear well.
Add tomatoes and water and pressure cook until tender.
Serve with rice.

name: Kerala Fish Fry (Meen Varuthathu)
description: Fish marinated in chilli, ginger and garlic and shallow fried.
steps: Grind chilli powder, ginger, garlic, turmeric, salt and lemon into a paste.
Coat the fish and marinate for 20 minutes.
Shallow fry in coconut oil with curry leaves until crisp.

name: Prawn Roast
description: Spicy Kerala prawns roasted with onions and curry leaves.
steps: Marinate prawns with chilli powder, turmeric and salt.
Saute onions until golden; add ginger, garlic and tomato.
Add prawns and roast until the masala coats them.
Finish with curry leaves.

name: Lauki Chana Dal
description: Light bottle gourd and chana dal curry.
steps: Soak chana dal for an hour.
Pressure cook with diced bottle gourd and turmeric.
Temper cumin, ginger and chilli; add tomato.
Combine with the dal and simmer.

name: Pasta in Fresh Tomato Sauce
description: Pasta tossed in a quick garlic-tomato sauce with herbs.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Saute garlic and onion in olive oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and herbs and simmer into a sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and garnish with basil.

name: Hakka Veg Noodles
description: Street-style noodles with cabbage, carrot and capsicum.
steps: Boil noodles, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add noodles, soy sauce and pepper and toss.
Garnish with spring onion.

name: Cauliflower Peas Masala with Chapati
description: Cauliflower and green peas in a light tomato gravy.
steps: Saute onion and ginger; add tomatoes and spices.
Add cauliflower, peas and a splash of water.
Cover and cook until tender.
Serve with chapatis.

name: Potato Masala Curry
description: Simple potato and onion curry that goes with dosa, puri or chapati.
steps: Boil, peel and roughly mash the potatoes.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; saute onion, ginger and chilli.
Add turmeric, potatoes and a little water and simmer.
Adjust salt and serve.

name: Spinach Mushroom Omelette
description: Protein-rich omelette folded with sauteed spinach and mushrooms.
steps: Saute garlic, mushrooms and spinach until wilted.
Pour in beaten eggs seasoned with salt and pepper.
Cook until set, fold and serve.
